items.description:
Got to review another Chinese car in the US, the new Li Auto L9, and holy moly https://t.co/H4WG9qJN8o

A few highlights: 
- 850 miles on 1 tank of gas (hybrid)
- 90Hz display front and rear screen with iPhone duo fold-down animation
- Steer by wire with adaptive steering ratio + rear wheel steer
- 800v system for fast charging, and adaptive suspension
- Speakers in the headrests, with heated pillows and armrests
- Adjustable rear window TINT
- 50W+ wireless phone chargers with cooling fans

items.title: Voyager 1 is the furthest manmade object from earth. It was launched nearly 50 years ago and has been hurtling through space at 30,000+ miles per hour ever since. Today it reached one full LIGHT-DAY from earth (the distance you travel in 24 hours going the speed of light - 16 billion miles!)
items.description:
Voyager 1 is the furthest manmade object from earth. It was launched nearly 50 years ago and has been hurtling through space at 30,000+ miles per hour ever since. Today it reached one full LIGHT-DAY from earth (the distance you travel in 24 hours going the speed of light - 16 billion miles!)

Earth's next CLOSEST star, Proxima Centauri, is a bit over 4 LIGHT YEARS away

The scale of the universe and how spread out everything is... is always absolutely nuts.

item.title: I cannot believe he’s still trying to claim he was right. Marques, be a man and honor your word.
item.description:
I cannot believe he’s still trying to claim he was right. Marques, be a man and honor your word.

Tesla showed you the future, and you called it “weird” and said FSD would never be approved for driverless, they would never be able to ship a car without a steering wheel, and they would not be able to hit a $30,000 price point due to inflation. You mocked them and said i’m so sure this will never happen I’ll shave my head if it does. 

You were WRONG. be a man and admit it. They showed you the future and you just didn’t get it. https://t.co/cHIsNIf6Go

item.title: The memes are everywhere, so let’s go back over the bet: Cybercab publicly available for under $30k by the end of 2026
item.description:
The memes are everywhere, so let’s go back over the bet: Cybercab publicly available for under $30k by the end of 2026

My hair is safe for several reasons
1: No deliveries yet. But they’re estimating starting in December so that’s neat
2: Invite only, not actually publicly available yet
3: You can’t actually use it as a cab(??!) It’s limited to private use only. Inside the existing geofenced locations. It’s a paperweight if I take this thing home. That’s one’s not actually part of the bet but yeah not exactly what was promised in this first wave

Hey @grok, set a timer for 48 days from now

item.title: Alright chat I’m in. Here’s the deal
item.description:
Alright chat I’m in. Here’s the deal

Cybercab order page is live. Invite only. Must accept delivery to one of these cities in Texas. Only operates in those existing geofenced areas. Requires a $300 monthly subscription to operate. One vehicle per customer. “Estimated delivery” December
